newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PRICES EASE AMID BOURSE TECHNICAL PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: PRICES EASE AMID BOURSE TECHNICAL PROBLEMS.

text.p: * Total morning trade 26.2 million kroons.
* Talse index down 1.79 percent to 382.36
* Hoiupank was most active in morning trade to
ease to 229/232 kroons from 236.75 kroons on 9.3 million kroons.
* Hansapank was also down in early trade at
217/220 kroons vs 222.50 kroons on 5.9 million kroons of trade.
* Technical problems with the bourse trading system saw
trade delayed for over an hour.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Prices on Wednesday began to ease after several days of a bull run, but dealers see shares ending little changed.
"Prices eased after the bourse finally opened, but stocks like Hoiupank are already starting to rebound after their slight fall," one dealer said.
Hoiupank registered trade of 11 million kroons to be lower at a spread of 229/232 kroons versus 236.75 kroons.
"Hoiupank fell to 229 kroons but has already moved back to 232 kroons," another trader added.
"I think that the bourse will hold around yesterday's price levels as the outlook is still positive," he added.

Dealers said that combined technical problems on the bourse and news that the Russian St Petersburg tax police had frozen the foreign exchange accounts of Forekspank in St Petersburg banks had also helped cool the bourse.
"Althought both things will prove to be small, they had the effect to slowing down the bourse," another trader said.
Uhispank was next most active stock with 10.1 million kroons traded to rise to 79.50/81 kroons vs 75.75 kroons.
Hansapank was lower at 218.50/220 kroons vs 222.50 kroons.
On the free market, privatisation securities were the most active, but trade was only 113,941 kroons.
The securities were down to 0.401/0.414 vs 0.419 kroons.
